title: This VIX Trade Breaks Even Most of the Time — And Wins Big in Crashes
summary: AJ Brown (Trading Trainer) pitches a defined-risk long-VIX portfolio hedge: a 'double vertical spread' (a $1-wide call debit spread below spot VIX financed by a bull-put credit spread above), entered at VIX lows on a MACD 6-19-3 signal, that breaks even most of the time and pays off on a fear spike. The crash payoff is capped at the $1 widths and the advertised 5-20x multiples are on a near-zero cost basis, while a VIX collapse can lose the full ~20% allocation. Write-up: strategies/vix_crash_hedge.md (conviction 2/5).
